name: Financial Filing Screening
description: Run a fixed openJiuwen workflow on local SEC annual-report files, retaining policy decisions and source evidence.

display_description.en: Screen local SEC reports with model-assisted extraction, Python policy checks and source-cited JSON results.
display_description.zh: 读取本地 SEC 年报，以模型提取财务证据、代码执行规则，输出附来源引用的筛查结果并保留未核实项。

default_init_input.en: Inspect my SEC filing folder and show the company, fiscal year and available reports without calling a model.
default_init_input.zh: 检查我的 SEC 年报目录，不调用模型，显示公司、财年和可用报表。

quick_inputs.en: Inspect my SEC filing folder and show the company, fiscal year and available reports without calling a model.
quick_inputs.zh: 检查我的 SEC 年报目录，不调用模型，显示公司、财年和可用报表。

quick_inputs.en: Screen this SEC filing using the configured local model and save a decision with source citations.
quick_inputs.zh: 使用已配置的本地模型筛查这份 SEC 年报，保存决策和来源引用。

quick_inputs.en: Explain the financial checks and unresolved risks in my completed screening report.
quick_inputs.zh: 解释已完成筛查报告中的财务检查和未核实风险。

display_description.en: Inspect or screen a local rendered filing and write an auditable JSON report.
display_description.zh: 检查或筛查本地财报，生成包含来源引用的 JSON 报告。
